title: Hillsboro / 12 South Luxe Home - Rooftop - 2mi DT
description:
This 4BR/4BA townhouse near Belmont and Vanderbilt University is walkable to Hillsboro Village and 12 South. It offers a stylish, light-filled retreat for up to 12 guests. Enjoy a rooftop deck, 2-car garage, and spacious layout perfect for groups and families. Features include a fully equipped kitchen, Smart TVs, washer/dryer, and en-suite baths in every bedroom. Walk or drive to 12 South, Music Row, and Downtown Nashville for dining, live music, and entertainment.

The space
Enjoy Nashville in style at this modern 4-bedroom, 4-bath townhouse near Belmont University! Designed for comfort and connection, this home blends sleek finishes with soft, welcoming touches. With room for up to 12 guests, it’s ideal for groups, families, or colleagues exploring Music City together.

Gather in the open-concept living room with exposed brick walls, cozy seating, and modern décor — or take the evening to the rooftop deck for fresh air and skyline views.

1st Floor
• Bedroom with queen bed, en-suite bath (shower/tub combo)
• Access to private 2-car garage

2nd Floor
• Fully stocked kitchen with stainless-steel appliances, Keurig, and breakfast bar
• Bright living area with sofa, Smart TV, and dining for 4
• Bedroom with two full beds and private bath

3rd Floor
• Primary suite with king bed, Smart TV, soaking tub, and walk-in shower
• Bedroom with two full beds and en-suite bath
• In-unit washer & dryer

4th Floor
• Rooftop deck with lounge seating and string lights — perfect for relaxing nights in!

Parking
• Private 2-car garage
• Additional first-come, first-serve street parking
Important: We are not responsible for towing, tickets, damages, or theft to your vehicle

Why Guests Love It
✓ 4 bedrooms, each with a private bath
✓ Rooftop deck for unwinding or entertaining
✓ Fast Wi-Fi + Smart TVs
✓ Garage and street parking
✓ Modern art and design accents throughout

You’ll have the whole townhouse to yourself — stylish, spacious, and just minutes from everything that makes Nashville shine. Book your stay today!

Guest access
Guests have private access to the entire townhouse, garage, rooftop deck, and laundry area. Entry is keyless for a smooth and secure self-check-in experience.

Other things to note
Please review the following information before booking:

By booking this property, you agree to all policies listed below:

GUEST REQUIREMENTS AND VERIFICATION
The primary guest must be at least 23 years old and must stay at the property throughout the reservation unless written approval is provided in advance. The primary guest is responsible for the reservation and the conduct of all registered guests and visitors.
For the safety and protection of our guests and properties, reservations may require identity verification and screening through a secure third-party service. This may include a signed rental agreement, valid government-issued photo identification, a live selfie, and reservation screening. The name on the identification must match the name on the reservation.
When required, verification instructions will be emailed after booking and must be completed before check-in instructions are released. Please check your spam or junk folder if you do not receive the email.
SECURITY DEPOSIT
For reservations where a security deposit is applicable and disclosed, a $350 refundable security deposit is required before check-in.
The deposit may be applied toward documented costs resulting from property damage, missing items, excessive cleaning, smoking, unauthorized pets or occupants, lockouts, lost access items, or other house-rule violations. Any remaining balance will be released after check-out in accordance with the reservation terms.
HOUSE-RULE VIOLATIONS, DAMAGES, AND CHARGES
Guests are responsible for following all house rules, property policies, and community requirements disclosed in the listing or provided before check-in.
House-rule violations may result in charges starting at $350 when the violation causes or requires additional cleaning, remediation, property damage, replacement of missing items, lockout or security services, unauthorized occupancy or pet-related costs, or another documented loss or expense.
The amount requested will be based on the circumstances and supported by applicable evidence, such as photographs, videos, inspection reports, guest communications, device records, estimates, receipts, or invoices. Charges may exceed $350 when the documented cost of addressing the violation is greater.
Serious or repeated violations, fraudulent activity, or conduct that threatens people, property, or the peaceful enjoyment of others may result in termination of the stay and removal from the property. Refund eligibility will be determined according to the reservation terms and applicable policies.
HOUSE RULES
• Smoking, parties, events, disruptive behavior, and excessive noise are prohibited.
• Quiet hours and all property or community rules must be followed.
• Only registered guests are permitted, and maximum occupancy may not be exceeded.
• Pets are not allowed unless expressly permitted by the listing or approved in writing.
• Furniture, décor, appliances, and electronics may not be moved or altered.
• Tampering with locks, Wi-Fi equipment, monitoring devices, cameras, or safety equipment is prohibited.
• Mail and package deliveries are not permitted. The host is not responsible for lost, delayed, or returned deliveries.
• Glitter, confetti, paint, glue, and unapproved decorations are prohibited.
• Guests must maintain reasonable cleanliness and promptly report damage or maintenance concerns.
CHECK-IN AND CHECK-OUT
Standard check-in begins at 4:00 PM, and check-out is by 11:00 AM unless otherwise stated in the listing. Early check-in and late check-out requests are subject to availability, must be approved in advance, and may incur an additional fee.
PARKING
If parking is provided, guests must follow all posted signs and property-specific parking instructions. When a parking pass, permit, vehicle registration, or assigned space is required, it must be used as instructed throughout the stay.
Vehicles parked without the required authorization or in reserved, restricted, or unauthorized areas may be ticketed, booted, or towed at the vehicle owner’s expense. The host is not responsible for towing, storage, retrieval, citations, or related fees.
ACCESS ITEMS AND LOCKOUTS
If keys, fobs, remotes, access cards, parking passes, or other access items are provided, guests are responsible for keeping them secure and using them only as instructed. All provided items must be returned to the designated location before check-out.
Lost, damaged, or unreturned access items and lockout assistance may result in additional charges. Guests may not copy, share, alter, or tamper with keys, access codes, locks, or entry devices.
AMENITIES
If amenities are provided, guests must follow all posted rules, operating hours, occupancy limits, and access instructions. Shared or community amenities may occasionally be unavailable due to maintenance, weather, management decisions, local regulations, or other circumstances outside the host’s control.
Amenity access and availability are not guaranteed, and refunds will not be issued solely because an amenity is temporarily closed, restricted, or unavailable.
MAINTENANCE AND PROPERTY ACCESS
Routine maintenance, inspections, pest control, or other property services may occur during a stay. Authorized personnel may require access for scheduled service, necessary repairs, inspections, safety concerns, or emergencies. We will provide advance notice whenever reasonably possible.
Guests may not interfere with authorized service or tamper with smoke detectors, carbon monoxide detectors, fire extinguishers, locks, or other safety equipment.
NOISE MONITORING
This property is equipped with a Minut noise-decibel monitor. The device measures sound levels and their duration to help identify excessive noise and protect the surrounding community. It does not record audio or conversations and is not a camera.
Tampering with, disabling, covering, unplugging, or removing the device is prohibited and may result in additional charges or termination of the stay.
NOISE AND SURROUNDINGS
Some properties are located within residential, mixed-use, or shared communities. Occasional noise from neighbors, traffic, construction, community activities, landscaping, or city maintenance may occur and may be outside the host’s control.
WI-FI AND UTILITIES
Wi-Fi and utilities are provided for guest convenience. Temporary interruptions caused by service providers, building management, weather, maintenance, or other circumstances outside the host’s control may occur. Please notify us promptly if you experience an issue so we can assist.
POLICY ENFORCEMENT
The host reserves the right to terminate a stay and require immediate departure if there is evidence of serious or repeated house-rule violations, fraudulent activity, or behavior that threatens the safety of others, the property, or the quiet enjoyment of guests, residents, or neighbors. When permitted under the reservation terms and applicable policies, termination may occur without a refund.
